items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Joe's brother. I didn't know Joe then, you know.

ctx.x: And how old were you when you came to town? I was about seven years old. About seven years old. So you knew all that gang around that neighborhood? Everybody. Around that Coliseum Square and all? Yeah.

Raps came to them and played guitar out there, man. I said to them to play guitar, rap, and Paul too. Joe's brother. I didn't know Joe then, you know. Paul Morris. Yeah, I knew Paul. Then in Chicago, when I played Fry's Inn, I used to go up there. Used to go up to Fry's Inn?
